summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.51/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.51 a gallon across Wisconsin as of July 5, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 9¢ lower than a week ago, 45¢ lower than a month ago, and 63¢ higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Racine ($3.37) and the highest in Mosinee ($3.71).
